bindings_and_boundaries: Pinned readiness/cohort/historical metadata fix PAT05 TRAIN, exact bundle/semantic/planning/support lineage and accepted-inventory ordering. Modified authority records fail before load_case.

The helper reconstructs only the recorded initial DTO, checks its complete fingerprint and mask, then the context checks source, track,64-cubed crop,71 actions,horizon3 and empty cavity before any checkpoint byte access or model construction.

Only pinned RL-000 and RL-256 bytes/tensor hashes/architecture/training declaration are eligible. Each checkpoint attempt is consumed before loading and cannot retry in the worker context. The default loader/admission code is unchanged.
The new context is rejected by imitation, REINFORCE and gradient APIs; the default pinned SynthStrip rejection remains effective.

Static reviewed path builds source/observation containers without constructing a task or native engine, proposing new actions, previewing geometry, stepping, searching or learning. Counts of prohibited operations are declarative zero counters justified by the frozen code path, not a runtime sandbox against arbitrary monkeypatching.

Each model is eval/frozen/inference-only and checked again for unchanged tensor/architecture identity and absence of gradients; raw checkpoint bytes are rechecked. Two completed outputs are required for successful worker closure.
decision: No remaining concrete blocker found for the declared one PAT05 historical-initial-DTO/two-checkpoint compatibility attempt; no actual patient execution was performed by this reviewer.

fixed_finding.independent_confirmation: The original failing orchestration regression now passes. Root-added initial/second-checkpoint failure tests were inspected; they were not repeated by this reviewer.

limitations: This review intentionally did not test actual PAT05 reconstruction, patient arrays or frozen checkpoint forwards. A fingerprint mismatch or resource failure must be retained without fallback.
The supervisor uses sampled worker RSS and polled wall thresholds with termination grace; actual measured runtime/memory should be reported.
Byte and DTO identity checks establish compatibility with the pinned historical research inputs, not independent source authenticity, clinical availability, anatomical correctness or real transfer.
semantics: The pair compares two generated-trained checkpoints on one already-consulted historical initial TRAIN observation; it is not two procedural states or held-out evaluation.

The exact historical mask remains an unreviewed synthetic-trained SynthStrip estimate. It affects support, normalization, access and the original candidate preparation; reconstruction does not admit it as observed tissue or cortex.
The supplied tumor annotation is used as a nominal target; its clinical availability/review is unknown. Empty cavity/access are hypothetical, despite retained historical DTO provenance labels.
STOP plus70 saved simulator-feasibility-filtered proposals remain simulator-derived inputs. Reusing them avoids new previews but does not establish scan-only deployment compatibility.
Missing motor/language/vascular/deformation/force evidence remains unknown. Outputs are uncalibrated value/action preferences, not safety, deficit probability or clinical outcomes.

The generated-to-historical shifts in crop, normalization, tool geometry, action inventory and horizon2-to3 are described. Previous preparation cost is separate from two forward timings; no end-to-end planning speed claim follows.
